name: checkout-edge-cases
notes: Several rules cooperating in one scenario, and the matchers the other examples don't reach: matching on HTTP method, on a query parameter, and on request-body content; custom response headers; and a bodyless 204. The first rule only fires for a POST to /api/v1/checkout that carries ?mode=test AND an expired coupon in the body — anything else falls through to the real API.

error.message: That coupon is no longer valid.
